source_term: weakening / contraction / exchange / cut (sequent-calculus structural rules)
technical_sense: The university and Vishwakosh sources establish inference-rule and sequent-calculus vocabulary. MR-P097 directly lists आकुंचन for contraction. MR-P096 gives the adjacent logic term विपर्यय for commutation, but the frozen A,B to B,A diagrams make the ordinary अदलाबदल clearer for exchange. No checked official source attested the exact proof-theory labels for weakening, exchange or cut. दुर्बलीकरण is a reversible process noun, and कट retains the recognizable formal label while avoiding छेद, already used for set intersection and Dedekind cuts. Every local sense is fixed by its displayed rule.
